svg.text: TEXAS PERSONAL AUTO POLICY TX 01-PAP-003 • PART A: LIABILITY COVERAGE (PAGE 2 OF 51)
INSURING AGREEMENT: We will pay damages for bodily injury or property damage for which any covered person becomes legally responsible...
SECTION 1.1 — PERMISSIVE USE & STATUTORY RIGHT-OF-WAY COMPLIANCE
Coverage applies to any person using your covered auto with reasonable belief of entitlement
to do so. Telematics and video verification demonstrate driver proceeded lawfully across intersection
under illuminated circular green signal pursuant to Tex. Transp. Code § 544.007, maintaining
adequate defensive braking margins and reasonable speed under wet roadway conditions.
